purpose: A first-close breakout on LOW volume: BROKEN_OUT fires normally and a LOW_VOLUME flag is raised. Volume is a confidence feature and NEVER gates validity (HD-03).

rejection_rationale.candidate: Low volume VOIDING the breakout (a hard volume gate)
rejection_rationale.rejected_because: There is no volume validity gate (HD-03, §13.4). Low volume only lowers the confidence C4 component and raises a LOW_VOLUME flag; the breakout still fires.
rejection_rationale.numeric: V[16]=300000 vs trailing ~20-bar avg ~1,000,000 -> ratio ~0.30 -> LOW_VOLUME flag; but ln(C[16])=4.465908 > y_hat(16)+eps_break=4.444725 -> BROKEN_OUT fires at t=16 regardless.

rejection_rationale.rejected_because: HD-03: single-close confirmation; neither volume nor persistence delays the alert.

key_inequalities: Identical line and breakout close to GX-16 (B*=(12,88); breakout at t=16).
Breakout validity is independent of volume (HD-03): BROKEN_OUT still fires, confirmed_bar==breakout_bar==16.
Volume feeds confidence component C4 only.
geometry_check.notes: Companion to GX-16: same geometry/price, low volume. Proves volume is confidence-only, never a validity gate.
